biz_step_uri.description: Controlled vocabulary URI naming the business process step.

bizloc_gln.description: Identifier of the broader business location where objects may be found.

disp_uri.description: Controlled vocabulary URI describing the business condition after the event.

epc_uri.description: Electronic Product Code URI identifying the observed trade-item instance.

evt_id.description: Globally unique identifier assigned to the traceability event.

evt_ts.description: Date and time at which the business event occurred.

qty_uom.description: Unit of measure used for the event quantity.

qty_val.description: Quantity of the product class participating in the event.

rp_gln.description: Identifier of the precise read point at which capture occurred.

tz_delta.description: Offset from UTC in force at the event location.
